You turn the bow across your body and loose as the charging enemy reaches you.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible enemy immediately after it ends voluntary movement adjacent to you.
Equipment / acquisition
Use an ordinary ranged weapon and ammunition, supplied on learning if needed: one Bulk 1 weapon and one Bulk 1 d8 ammunition bundle.
Type
Skill / Attack

Make one free Basic Ranged attack against the enemy.
